map.花粉（发酵）全营养检测 使用指南: Pollen (Fermented) Full Nutrition Test User Guide
map.按蛋白质、脂肪、还原糖、水分、灰分与乳酸含量评估（发酵）蜂花粉的营养品质与发酵程: Assess the nutritional quality and fermentation degree of (fermented) bee pollen from protein, fat, reducing sugar, moisture, ash and lactate content, assisting raw-material quality judgement and pricing.
map.逐项判级：蛋白质/还原糖/乳酸 ≥ 标准为合格、≥ 优良值为优；脂肪在区间内为合: Grade each item: protein / reducing sugar / lactate ≥ the standard is compliant, ≥ the excellent value is premium; fat within the band is compliant; moisture / ash ≤ the standard is compliant; special grade = ≥5 premium items
map.对（发酵）蜂花粉按 6 项营养与发酵指标逐项评分：蛋白质、还原糖、乳酸为「越高越: Score (fermented) bee pollen item by item on six nutrition and fermentation indicators: protein, reducing sugar and lactate are "higher is better", moisture and ash are "lower is better", while fat must fall in a suitable range. The number of compliant and premium items determines the overall grade (special / first-class / second-class / non-conforming), and the tool points toward process or raw-material improvements, assisting quality judgement and purchase pricing.
map.录入（发酵）蜂花粉的蛋白质、脂肪、还原糖、水分、灰分与乳酸含量，逐项判级。: Enter the protein, fat, reducing sugar, moisture, ash and lactate content of (fermented) bee pollen and grade each item.
map.按合格项与达优项数量评定综合等级，辅助原料收购定价与发酵工艺改进。: Grade the overall level by the number of compliant and premium items, assisting raw-material purchase pricing and fermentation process improvement.
map.一批发酵花粉评级: Rating a batch of fermented pollen
map.：蛋白质 18%、脂肪 4%、还原糖 16%、水分 7%、灰分 3.5%、乳酸: : protein 18%, fat 4%, reducing sugar 16%, moisture 7%, ash 3.5%, lactate 1.2%: protein, reducing sugar and lactate meet the standard, fat falls in the suitable 1%~7% band, moisture ≤8% and ash ≤4% — all six compliant with protein and reducing sugar premium, giving an overall grade of first-class.

map.乳酸是蜂花粉发酵程度的指标：含量升高说明发酵较充分、更易消化吸收；过低表示发酵不: Lactate indicates the degree of pollen fermentation: a higher level means more thorough fermentation and easier digestion/absorption; too low means insufficient fermentation, too high may mean it has turned sour, so judge together with smell and appearance.
map.水分和灰分为什么越低越好？: Why are lower moisture and ash better?
map.水分高易霉变、缩短保质期；灰分高说明泥沙等杂质多。两者属「越低越好」型指标，超过: High moisture invites mildew and shortens shelf life; high ash means more silt and other impurities. Both are "lower is better" indicators — exceeding the standard means non-conforming — used for quick screening of raw-material cleanliness and dryness.
map.综合等级是怎么定的？: How is the overall grade determined?
map.按 6 项指标的合格数与达优数分级：达优 ≥5 项为特级；合格 ≥5 项为一级；: Grade by the number of compliant and premium items across the six indicators: ≥5 premium items is special grade; ≥5 compliant items is first-class; ≥4 compliant items is second-class; otherwise non-conforming. Grades are for reference only; actual purchasing also depends on origin and test reports.
